purpose: Define provenance-rich candidate-corpus conditions for curation validation before data acquisition, training, or benchmark outcomes.

clean_retain_all.purpose: Confirm that an eligible corpus fitting the declared budget retains all records rather than forcing reduction.
clean_retain_all.required_stage0_observation: all release candidates have provenance and allowed rights

raw_mixed.purpose: Primary curation condition with raw-like records, known-reference context, duplicates, malformed records, and quarantined hazards.

risk_heavy.purpose: Stress condition with a high raw-like share and injected risk cases to verify quarantine, abstention, and insufficient-usable-data behavior.
risk_heavy.required_stage0_observation: hazard reasons and unresolved-rights cases remain outside the release candidate pool

materialization_requirements: per-condition raw, Stage-0, Stage-A, and Stage-B record/chunk/token counts
source and transformation lineage manifest with sha256
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
